assignments.name: Count_Waiting_Siblings
assignments.description: Counts the number of sibling ChangeRequestRelatedItem records with Application_Status__c = '대기' and stores the count in Sibling_Waiting_Count variable
assignments.label: Count Waiting Siblings

decisions.name: Check_No_Waiting_And_Parent_Status
decisions.description: Evaluates two conditions: (1) Sibling_Waiting_Count equals 0 (no waiting siblings exist), AND (2) parent ChangeRequest Status equals '적용중'. Routes to update element only when both conditions are true.

rules.name: No_Waiting_And_Parent_Applying
rules.description: Checks if no waiting siblings exist (count = 0) and parent ChangeRequest Status is '적용중'
rules.label: No Waiting And Parent Applying

decisions.label: Check No Waiting And Parent Status

recordLookups.description: Query all sibling ChangeRequestRelatedItem records with the same ChangeRequestId where Application_Status__c equals '대기' to determine if any waiting siblings exist
recordLookups.label: Query Sibling Waiting Records
recordLookups.name: Query_Sibling_Waiting_Records

recordUpdates.name: Update_Parent_To_Reflect_Complete
recordUpdates.description: Updates the parent ChangeRequest record Status to '반영완료' when all sibling ChangeRequestRelatedItem records are complete (no waiting siblings exist) and parent Status is '적용중'
recordUpdates.label: Update Parent To Reflect Complete

variables.name: Sibling_Waiting_Count
variables.description: Stores the count of sibling ChangeRequestRelatedItem records with Application_Status__c = '대기' to determine if any waiting siblings exist
